diagrams.title: Diagram 1 — How Retrieval Augmented Generation works
diagrams.caption: Diagram 1 — How Retrieval Augmented Generation works
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 700 150" aria-label="RAG three step flow" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs><marker id="a1" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto"><path d="M2 1L8 5L2 9" fill="none" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"></path></marker></defs>
        <rect x="8" y="52" width="120" height="46" rx="8" fill="#241d16" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="68" y="72" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">User query</text>
        <text class="sm" x="68" y="88" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">the question</text>
        <line x1="128" y1="75" x2="168" y2="75" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a1)"></line>
        <rect x="168" y="52" width="120" height="46" rx="8" fill="#1d2833" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="228" y="72" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">1 · Retrieve</text>
        <text class="sm" x="228" y="88" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">search the data</text>
        <line x1="288" y1="75" x2="328" y2="75" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a1)"></line>
        <rect x="328" y="52" width="120" height="46" rx="8" fill="#282034" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="388" y="72" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">2 · Augment</text>
        <text class="sm" x="388" y="88" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">context + query</text>
        <line x1="448" y1="75" x2="488" y2="75" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a1)"></line>
        <rect x="488" y="52" width="120" height="46" rx="8" fill="#22301f" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="548" y="72" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">3 · Generate</text>
        <text class="sm" x="548" y="88" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">grounded answer</text>
        <line x1="608" y1="75" x2="648" y2="75" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a1)"></line>
        <text class="sm" x="672" y="79" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">answer</text>
      </svg>

diagrams.title: Diagram 2 — The RAG pipeline, from raw documents to a final answer
diagrams.caption: Diagram 2 — The RAG pipeline, from raw documents to a final answer
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 700 210" aria-label="RAG pipeline seven stages" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs><marker id="a2" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto"><path d="M2 1L8 5L2 9" fill="none" stroke="#a99a88" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"></path></marker></defs>
        <text class="sx" x="8" y="18" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;font-size:10px;fill:#7d7160">INDEXING (done once, ahead of time)</text>
        <rect x="8" y="28" width="150" height="42" rx="8" fill="#241d16" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="83" y="45" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">1 · Load data</text>
        <text class="sm" x="83" y="61" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">ingest documents</text>
        <line x1="158" y1="49" x2="190" y2="49" stroke="#a99a88" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a2)"></line>
        <rect x="190" y="28" width="150" height="42" rx="8" fill="#241d16" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="265" y="45" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">2 · Chunk</text>
        <text class="sm" x="265" y="61" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">split into pieces</text>
        <line x1="340" y1="49" x2="372" y2="49" stroke="#a99a88" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a2)"></line>
        <rect x="372" y="28" width="150" height="42" rx="8" fill="#241d16" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="447" y="45" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">3 · Embed</text>
        <text class="sm" x="447" y="61" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">text → vectors</text>
        <line x1="522" y1="49" x2="554" y2="49" stroke="#a99a88" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a2)"></line>
        <rect x="554" y="28" width="138" height="42" rx="8" fill="#241d16" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="623" y="45" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">4 · Store</text>
        <text class="sm" x="623" y="61" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">vector database</text>
        <text class="sx" x="8" y="112" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;font-size:10px;fill:#7d7160">QUERY TIME (every question)</text>
        <rect x="8" y="122" width="150" height="42" rx="8" fill="#1d2833" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="83" y="139" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">5 · Retrieve</text>
        <text class="sm" x="83" y="155" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">top-k matches</text>
        <line x1="158" y1="143" x2="190" y2="143" stroke="#a99a88" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a2)"></line>
        <rect x="190" y="122" width="182" height="42" rx="8" fill="#1d2833" stroke="#3a3025" stroke-dasharray="4 3"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="281" y="139" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">6 · Filter & rerank</text>
        <text class="sm" x="281" y="155" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">optional quality step</text>
        <line x1="372" y1="143" x2="404" y2="143" stroke="#a99a88" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a2)"></line>
        <rect x="404" y="122" width="182" height="42" rx="8" fill="#22301f" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="495" y="139" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">7 · Generate answer</text>
        <text class="sm" x="495" y="155" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">LLM + retrieved context</text>
        <text class="sx" x="600" y="147" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;font-size:10px;fill:#7d7160">→ user</text>
      </svg>

diagrams.title: Diagram 3 — An AI agent as a travel planner, using agentic RAG

        <text class="sm" x="283" y="130" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">reason → plan →</text>

        <rect x="428" y="103" width="200" height="44" rx="8" fill="#1d2833" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="528" y="121" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">API: live forecast</text>
        <text class="sm" x="528" y="137" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">real-time data</text>

        <text class="sm" x="528" y="214" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">"pack light, hates cold"</text>

diagrams.title: Diagram 4 — Progression from basic LLM capabilities to multi-agent systems
diagrams.caption: Diagram 4 — Progression from basic LLM capabilities to multi-agent systems
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 700 260" aria-label="Progression from LLM to multi-agent systems" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs><marker id="a4" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto"><path d="M2 1L8 5L2 9" fill="none" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"></path></marker></defs>
        <rect x="10" y="20" width="660" height="40" rx="8" fill="#241d16" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="26" y="38" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">1 · Plain LLM</text>
        <text class="sm" x="26" y="53" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">Answers from training data alone. Knows a lot, can do nothing.</text>
        <line x1="340" y1="60" x2="340" y2="72" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a4)"></line>
        <rect x="10" y="76" width="660" height="40" rx="8" fill="#241d16" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="26" y="94" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">2 · Chatbot</text>
        <text class="sm" x="26" y="109" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">Adds memory of the conversation. Now it can hold a dialogue.</text>
        <line x1="340" y1="116" x2="340" y2="128" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a4)"></line>
        <rect x="10" y="132" width="660" height="40" rx="8" fill="#1d2833" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="26" y="150" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">3 · RAG chatbot</text>
        <text class="sm" x="26" y="165" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">Adds retrieval. Now it is grounded in your data and current facts.</text>
        <line x1="340" y1="172" x2="340" y2="184" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a4)"></line>
        <rect x="10" y="188" width="660" height="40" rx="8" fill="#3a2a1a" stroke="#ff8c42"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="26" y="206" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">4 · Agent</text>
        <text class="sm" x="26" y="221" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">Adds tools + a reasoning loop. Now it can act, check, and retry.</text>
        <line x1="340" y1="228" x2="340" y2="240" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a4)"></line>
        <rect x="10" y="244" width="660" height="14" rx="6" fill="#282034" stroke="#b9a2e0"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="26" y="255" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">5 · Multi-agent system — specialised agents cooperating on one goal</text>
      </svg>

diagrams.title: Diagram 5 — MCP workflow
diagrams.caption: Diagram 5 — MCP workflow: the client discovers a server's capabilities, then calls them
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 700 170" aria-label="MCP client server workflow" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs><marker id="a5" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto"><path d="M2 1L8 5L2 9" fill="none" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"></path></marker></defs>
        <rect x="20" y="52" width="170" height="66" rx="10" fill="#3a2a1a" stroke="#ff8c42"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="105" y="78" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">Agent (MCP client)</text>
        <text class="sm" x="105" y="96" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">has the model</text>
        <text class="sm" x="105" y="110" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">and the reasoning</text>
        <line x1="190" y1="72" x2="380" y2="72" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a5)"></line>
        <text class="sx" x="285" y="65" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;font-size:10px;fill:#7d7160">1 · what can you do?</text>
        <line x1="380" y1="98" x2="190" y2="98" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a5)"></line>
        <text class="sx" x="285" y="115" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;font-size:10px;fill:#7d7160">2 · list of tools / resources / prompts</text>
        <rect x="380" y="30" width="290" height="110" rx="10" fill="#1d2833" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="525" y="52" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">MCP server</text>
        <text class="sm" x="400" y="76" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">• Tools — actions the agent can perform</text>
        <text class="sm" x="400" y="96" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">• Resources — data the agent can read</text>
        <text class="sm" x="400" y="116" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">• Prompts — reusable prompt templates</text>
      </svg>
